6896-a-brief-history-of-the-united-state.title: A Brief History Of The United States
6896-a-brief-history-of-the-united-state.creator: JOHN BACH McMASTER
6896-a-brief-history-of-the-united-state.description: A book by JOHN BACH McMASTER. Much of the machinery sometimes used in history teaching--bibliographies, extensive collateral readings, judgment questions, and the like--have been omitted as out of place in a brief school history. Better results may be obtained by having the pupils write simple narratives in their own words, covering important periods and topics in our history: as, the discovery of America; the exploration of our coast and continent; the settlements that failed; the planting of the English colonies; the life of the colonists; the struggles for possession of

arxiv-1907-12563.title: Embedding planetesimals into white dwarf discs from large distances 2019 Embedding planetesimals into white dwarf discs from large distances – References
arxiv-1907-12563.creator: Evgeni Grishin, Dimitri Veras
arxiv-1907-12563.description: Abstract The discovery of the intact minor planet embedded in the debris disc orbiting SDSS J1228+1040 raises questions about the dynamical history of the system. Further, the recent passage of the potentially interstellar object 1I/’Oumuamua within the solar system has re-ignited interest in minor body flux through exoplanetary systems.

arxiv-2211-06693.title: Smoluchowski coagulation equation with velocity dependence
arxiv-2211-06693.creator: Franco Flandoli, Ruojun Huang, Andrea Papini
arxiv-2211-06693.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Franco Flandoli, Ruojun Huang, Andrea Papini. In the present article, we introduce a variant of Smoluchowski’s coagulation equation with both position and velocity variables taking a kinetic viewpoint arising as the scaling limit of a system of second-order (microscopic) coagulating particles. We focus on the rigorous study of the PDE system in the spatially-homogeneous case proving existence and uniqueness under different initial conditions in suitable weighted space, investigating also the regularity of such solutions.

arxiv-2307-10144.title: The s ± -Wave Pairing and the Destructive Role of Apical-Oxygen Deficiencies in La 3 Ni 2 O 7 Under Pressure
arxiv-2307-10144.creator: Yu-Bo Liu, Jia-Wei Mei, Fei Ye, Wei-Qiang Chen, Fan Yang
arxiv-2307-10144.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Yu-Bo Liu, Jia-Wei Mei, Fei Ye, Wei-Qiang Chen, Fan Yang. Recently, the bilayer perovskite nickelate La 3 Ni 2 O 7 has been reported to show evidence of high-temperature superconductivity (SC) under a moderate pressure of about 14 GPa.

arxiv-2311-15681.title: Bounds on ALP-Mediated Dark Matter Models from Celestial Objects
arxiv-2311-15681.creator: Tanech Klangburam, Chakrit Pongkitivanichkul
arxiv-2311-15681.description: Abstract We have studied the signals from axion-like particles (ALPs) as dark matter mediators from celestial objects such as neutron stars, brown dwarfs or white dwarfs. We consider the accumulation of dark matter inside the celestial objects using the multiscatter capturing process.

arxiv-2508-15810.title: Detecting Hope, Hate, and Emotion in Arabic Textual Speech and Multi-modal Memes Using Large Language Models
arxiv-2508-15810.creator: Nouar AlDahoul, Yasir Zaki
arxiv-2508-15810.description: Abstract The rise of social media and online communication platforms has led to the spread of Arabic textual posts and memes as a key form of digital expression. While these contents can be humorous and informative, they are also increasingly being used to spread offensive language and hate speech.

arxiv-2605-08780.creator: Anirban Polley

lucian-works-fowler-vol-4.creator: Lucian of Samosata (H. W. Fowler and F. G. Fowler, trans.)
lucian-works-fowler-vol-4.description: Vol. IV of the Fowler brothers' complete Lucian — including the 'Lover of Lies' (Philopseudes) with its sorcerer's-apprentice tale and 'Alexander the False Prophet', antiquity's sharpest satires of magicians and superstition.

pmc-11344066.title: Improving the explainability of autoencoder factors for commodities through forecast-based Shapley values
pmc-11344066.creator: Roy Cerqueti, Antonio Iovanella, Raffaele Mattera, Saverio Storani
pmc-11344066.description: Autoencoders are dimension reduction models in the field of machine learning which can be thought of as a neural network counterpart of principal components analysis (PCA). Due to their flexibility and good performance, autoencoders have been recently used for estimating nonlinear factor models in finance.

pmc-11360240.title: How to Compare Relative Age Effect in Different Sports? A New Methodological Approach—Example of Youth Olympic Games
pmc-11360240.creator: Drazen Cular, Matej Babic, Darko Katovic, Tea Beslija, Ana Kezic
pmc-11360240.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). This research aimed to propose a new methodological approach for analyzing relative age effect (RAE) in different sports or samples named “Relative age effect overall scale” (RAEOS). The sample consisted of 1455 male and female young athletes who competed in four different sports (basketball, n = 159; handball, n = 215; swimming, n = 981; taekwondo, n = 100) at the Youth Olympic Games (YOG) in Buenos Aires in 2018.

pmc-11506651.title: CDX2-Suppressed Colorectal Cancers Possess Potentially Targetable Alterations in Receptor Tyrosine Kinases and Other Colorectal-Cancer-Associated Pathways
pmc-11506651.creator: Ioannis A Voutsadakis, Julio Plaza-Díaz
pmc-11506651.description: Background: Colorectal cancer, a prevalent gastrointestinal carcinoma, has a high risk for recurrence when locally advanced and remains lethal when in an advanced stage. Prognostic biomarkers may help in better delineating the aggressiveness of this disease in individual patients and help to tailor appropriate therapies.

pmc-11541337.title: Identification of a Novel β-Defensin Gene in Gilthead Seabream (Sparus aurata)
pmc-11541337.creator: M. Ferez-Puche, Jhon A. Serna-Duque, Alberto Cuesta, Álvaro Sánchez-Ferrer, María Ángeles Esteban
pmc-11541337.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The excessive use of antibiotics in aquaculture favors the natural selection of multidrug-resistant bacteria, and antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) could be a promising alternative to this problem. The most studied AMPs in teleost fish are piscidins, hepcidins, and β-defensins. In this work, we have found a new gene (defb2) encoding a type 2 β-defensin in the genome of gilthead seabream, a species chosen for its economic interest in aquaculture.

pmc-11588987.title: Treatment of recurrent aphthous stomatitis with oral roflumilast, a multicenter observational study
pmc-11588987.creator: Rodrigo Peñuelas Leal, Leticia Bagan, Andrés Grau Echevarría, Jose Amancio Peñuelas Ruiz, Violeta Zaragoza Ninet, Jose Luis Sánchez Carazo, Gemma Pérez Pastor, Carolina Labrandero Hoyos, Malena Finello, Sandra Martínez Fernández, Daniel Blaya Imbernon, Ángel González García, Elena Pérez Zafrilla, Mi
pmc-11588987.description: IntroductionSevere recurrent aphthous stomatitis (RAS) represents a therapeutic challenge because of its impact on the patient's quality of life. Additionally, no approved systemic therapies are available. Roflumilast, a phosphodiesterase‐4 inhibitor, has shown promise in other inflammatory dermatological conditions. This study aimed to assess the characteristics, effectiveness, and safety of roflumilast in treating RAS in routine clinical practice.

pmc-11614730.title: The value of multi-parameter radiomics combined with imaging features in predicting the therapeutic efficacy of HIFU treatment for uterine fibroids
pmc-11614730.creator: Li Shen, Xiao Huang, YuYao Liu, QingXue Li, ShanWei Bai, Fang Wang, Quan Yang
pmc-11614730.description: ObjectivesTo evaluate the effectiveness of high-intensity focused ultrasound (HIFU) therapy for treating uterine fibroids by utilizing multi-sequence magnetic resonance imaging radiomic models.MethodsOne hundred and fifty patients in our hospital were randomly divided into a training cohort (n=120) and an internal test cohort (n=30), and forty-five patients from another hospital serving as an external test cohort.

pmc-11677953.title: Correction of Femoral Torsional Deformities by Rotational Guided Growth
pmc-11677953.creator: Michael Zaidman, Naum Simanovsky, Vladimir Goldman, Eden Weisstub
pmc-11677953.description: Background: Femoral torsional malalignment is a common cause of in-toeing and out-toeing in children, often leading to gait disturbances, functional limitations, and increased risk of falls. Traditionally, osteotomy was the only surgical option for correction. A minimally invasive technique known as rotational guided growth (RGG) has recently been introduced to address these malalignments.

pmc-11783849.title: A systematic literature review on digital literacy, employability, and innovative work behavior: emphasizing the contextual approaches in HRM research
pmc-11783849.creator: Angela Caroline, Martine J. H. Coun, Agus Gunawan, Jol Stoffers
pmc-11783849.description: Knowledge Society 5.0 and Industry 5.0 require workers with adaptable employability skills and who engage in innovative work behavior that help companies to create innovative products and processes that are difficult for competitors to imitate. Extant research examines employability, and innovative work behavior, but there are still few articles that include digital literacy in their study.

pmc-12470203.title: Cadmium in the Soil–Tea–Infusion Continuum of Selenium-Enriched Gardens: Implications for Food Safety
pmc-12470203.creator: Haizhong Wu, Dengxiao Zhang, Xiaolei Jie, Shiliang Liu, Daichang Wang
pmc-12470203.description: Tea trees (Camellia sinensis) growing on selenium (Se)-rich soils often exhibit the phenomenon of cadmium (Cd) accumulation. However, the transport of Cd in the soil–tea tree–tea infusion continuum in such areas, as well as the impact of Se on Cd in this system, remains enigmatic.

pmc-12998264.title: Coronary Fistula Between the Left Anterior Descending Coronary Artery and the Pulmonary Artery: A Case Report
pmc-12998264.creator: Mohammad Qaiser Aziz Khan, Iman Muhammad Tahir, Vijay Kumar, Marium Nastaeen Sarhandi, Ariful Haque
pmc-12998264.description: Timely diagnosis and management of coronary artery fistulas are vital to prevent complications. Advanced imaging and multidisciplinary care aid accurate treatment. Clinicians should consider coronary artery fistula in unexplained cardiac symptoms. When resources are limited, innovation like intraoperative fluoroscopy can ensure success. Always seek clarity when in doubt to guide clinical decisions.

pmc-13152915.title: Micro- and nanoplastic exposure, immune cell activation, and lung function in young adults
pmc-13152915.creator: Amanda M. Durkin, Tim L. P. Skrabanja, Ulrike Gehring, Runyu Zou, Virissa Lenters, Gerard H. Koppelman, Judith M. Vonk, Nienke Vrisekoop, Roel Vermeulen
pmc-13152915.description: RationaleMicro- and nanoplastics, an emerging public health concern, enter the human body through inhalation and ingestion. The potential for this exposure to induce a pro-inflammatory immune response or impair lung function remains unknown.ObjectivesThis study aimed to estimate exposure to micro- and nanoplastics in young adults and investigate associations with immune activation and lung function.

pmc-13227129.title: Antimicrobial and diagnostic stewardship: opportunities for return on investment
pmc-13227129.creator: Tracy Zembles, Blake Buchan, Katie Ray, Michelle Mitchell, Kelly Graff
pmc-13227129.description: Objective:Implementation of antimicrobial and diagnostic stewardship interventions can offer substantial return on investment while enhancing patient safety and healthcare quality. Clinical benefits include a decrease in antimicrobial resistance, shorter hospital stays, fewer adverse events from unnecessary antibiotic use, and optimized treatment protocols.

pmc-13238859.title: Māori Research Data Governance in New Zealand Universities
pmc-13238859.creator: Kiri West, Larissa Renfrew
pmc-13238859.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Universities in Aotearoa generate and hold large volumes of research data, including increasing amounts of Māori data shaped by Vision Mātauranga. Yet practice around Māori Data Sovereignty (MDSov) remains uneven, with commitments often aspirational rather than operational. This article assesses how Tiriti‐led institutions are upholding the mana and mauri of Māori data as taonga and identifies how bureaucratic inertia maintains the gap between policy signals and everyday research practice.

pmc-13253108.title: Non-decalcified human teeth sample preparation method for MALDI mass spectrometry imaging
pmc-13253108.creator: Kayle J Bender, Joanna E Spurgeon, Chuo Ying Zhai, Manish Arora, Elizabeth K Neumann
pmc-13253108.description: Background:Human teeth preserve a rich temporal record of biological and environmental information throughout an individual’s life. Accessing this record requires analytical techniques capable of providing both spatial and chemical resolution. Matrix-assisted laser desorption/ionization mass spectrometry imaging (MALDI MSI) offers powerful capabilities for visualizing the spatial distribution of biomolecules. However, successful analysis demands preservation of both morphology and chemical integrity.

pmc-13467862.title: Challenges and Technological Strategies to Enhance Probiotic Viability in Non-Dairy Food Matrices
pmc-13467862.creator: Stevens Duarte, Janaina Sánchez-García, Ester Betoret, Noelia Betoret

pmc-13660717.title: Self‐Efficacy, Healthy and Sustainable Lifestyle, and Life Satisfaction: An Integrated Model Accounting for Self‐Reported Recreational Physical Activity Participation Status in Veterinary Students
pmc-13660717.creator: Sevim Güllü, Alp Emre Yıldız, Maciej Witkowski, Hasan Hüseyin Arı, Ozan Gündemir
pmc-13660717.description: BackgroundVeterinary education is characterized by intensive curricula and demanding practical training, which may constrain students’ ability to maintain health‐promoting routines and sustainable lifestyle behaviors. In such contexts, general self‐efficacy—a psychological resource related to persistence and coping—may be associated with both lifestyle patterns and overall life satisfaction.
